C-GV.description: CIS Control 3, IG1, Data. TLCTC: Data governance: enabler for every DRE row.

C-ID.name: CIS 3.2 — Data inventory
C-ID.description: CIS Control 3, IG1, Data. TLCTC: The data at stake in any Data Risk Event; enabler for every DRE row.

C-ID.name: CIS 3.7 — Data classification scheme
C-ID.description: CIS Control 3, IG2, Data. TLCTC: Sensitivity labels steer the controls of every DRE row; enabler.

C-ID.name: CIS 3.8 — Data flow documentation
C-ID.description: CIS Control 3, IG2, Data. TLCTC: Shows where data travels, providers included; enabler for every DRE row.

C-PR.name: CIS 3.4 — Data retention limits
C-PR.description: CIS Control 3, IG1, Data. TLCTC: Data that is no longer kept cannot be disclosed after a compromise: shrinks the [DRE: C].

C-PR.name: CIS 3.5 — Secure data disposal
C-PR.description: CIS Control 3, IG1, Data. TLCTC: Discarded media can be recovered by whoever gets hold of them; disposal keeps that from becoming a [DRE: C].

C-PR.name: CIS 3.6 — Disk encryption on end-user devices
C-PR.description: CIS Control 3, IG1, Data, hardening. TLCTC: Acts after the System Risk Event (e.g. a stolen device, #8): keeps it from becoming a [DRE: C] (owner ruling 2026-10-01).

C-PR.name: CIS 3.9 — Encryption of removable media
C-PR.description: CIS Control 3, IG2, Data, hardening. TLCTC: Acts after the System Risk Event (a lost or taken medium): keeps it from becoming a [DRE: C].

C-PR.name: CIS 3.11 — Server-side encryption of stored sensitive data
C-PR.description: CIS Control 3, IG2, Data, hardening. TLCTC: Storage-layer encryption is transparent to the running system and only helps once media leave it: [DRE: C] protection.

C-PR.name: CIS 3.13 — Data loss prevention tooling
C-PR.description: CIS Control 3, IG3, Data. TLCTC: Stops sensitive data leaving, whichever cluster put it in motion: [DRE: C] protection.

C-PR.name: CIS 4.11 — Remote wipe of portable devices
C-PR.description: CIS Control 4, IG2, Data. TLCTC: Removes enterprise data from a lost or stolen device before the System Risk Event becomes a [DRE: C].

C-PR.name: CIS 11.3 — Protect backup data like the original
C-PR.description: CIS Control 11, IG1, Data, hardening. TLCTC: Backup copies are data too: keeps them from being disclosed (C) or altered (Ii).

C-PR.name: CIS 14.4 — Data handling training
C-PR.description: CIS Control 14, IG1, Users. TLCTC: People storing, sending and destroying sensitive data correctly limit the [DRE: C].

C-DE.name: CIS 3.14 — Log access to sensitive data
C-DE.description: CIS Control 3, IG3, Data, hardening. TLCTC: Records who read sensitive data: detects the [DRE: C] itself.

Ii-RC.name: CIS 11.2 — Automated backups
Ii-RC.description: CIS Control 11, IG1, Data. TLCTC: Backups restore altered (Ii), lost (Av) and unusable (Ac) data; they cannot repair misattribution (If).

Ii-RC.name: CIS 11.4 — Isolated copy of recovery data
Ii-RC.description: CIS Control 11, IG1, Data. TLCTC: An isolated copy survives the compromise that altered (Ii), deleted (Av) or locked (Ac) the primary data.

Ii-RC.name: CIS 11.5 — Test restores
Ii-RC.description: CIS Control 11, IG2, Data. TLCTC: Proves that altered (Ii), lost (Av) or unusable (Ac) data can actually be restored.
